reasons.text: An official World Gymnastics event and an international invitational competition — gymnasts from across Europe and the world, judges with international brevets. Routines you usually only see on TV, watched from the stands.

reasons.text: One of the longest-running rhythmic gymnastics competitions in Slovakia — the 27th edition under the banner of ŠK ŠOG Nitra and the Slovak Gymnastics Federation.

items.question: Where is the competition held and how do I get there?
items.answer: At the Nitra City Sports Hall — Dolnočermánska 105, Nitra – Klokočina — from Thursday 26 to Sunday 29 November 2026. It's under an hour by car from Bratislava and about 90 minutes from Vienna; parking is available right at the hall.

items.question: When are the finals?
items.answer: The WG apparatus finals (hoop, ball, clubs, ribbon) take place on Saturday 28 November, followed by the award ceremony. The weekend also hosts the Slovak National Group Championships, and Sunday belongs to the Open groups, doubles and triplets.

items.question: Is a ticket valid for the whole day?
items.answer: Yes — a day ticket covers all competition sessions of that day, and you can leave and come back. The 2-day ticket and the 4-day pass work the same way for each of the chosen days.

items.question: What does Early Bird mean?
items.answer: A discounted price for purchases until 31 October 2026 — it applies equally to arena tickets and to the livestream. From 1 November the full price applies. Prices are final, nothing is added.

items.question: How does the livestream work?
items.answer: Buy access at tickets.sgf.sk and watch at stream.sgf.sk after signing in with the same e-mail. It works on phones, laptops and smart TVs. Access is active right after payment.

items.question: Can I return a ticket or move it to another day?
items.answer: Tickets are tied to a specific day or days. Refund and exchange conditions follow the terms and conditions of tickets.sgf.sk — you'll find them at checkout.

items.question: Who organises the competition?
items.answer: ŠK ŠOG Nitra – rhythmic gymnastics (MODERGYM) in cooperation with the Slovak Gymnastics Federation and the Secondary Sports School Nitra. The event is an official World Gymnastics competition. Contact: Zuzana Vilčeková, christmas.nitra@gmail.com, +421 911 430 001.

info.label: Getting there
info.text: Under 60 minutes by car from Bratislava, about 90 minutes from Vienna. The hall is in the Klokočina district, a few minutes from Nitra's centre.

info.label: Parking
info.text: Parking right at the hall on Dolnočermánska street.

info.label: Entry
info.text: Doors open one hour before the first session. Just show your e-ticket with QR code on your phone.

info.label: For visitors
info.text: Your ticket is valid all day — leave between sessions and come back. Festive Nitra is a few minutes from the hall.

info.label: The hall
info.text: One competition floor and two training floors, 15 m ceiling height — the home of Christmas Nitra.

info.label: Accommodation
info.text: Partner hotels with the code “Christmas Nitra 2026”: H11, Centrum, City, OKO and Zobor.
